description: Monitor all of Robinhood's stock tokens in one call: integrity incidents, newest first. An incident is a token whose supply or treasury balance diverged from its full mint/burn ledger, or a ledger rebaseline, with its type, status and block window. type=integrity (default), operational (collector errors) or all. On-chain observations and reconciliation findings, not financial advice. Costs $0.005 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Arbitrum One).

limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20). Not refused when outside: above 100 is cut to 100, below 1 becomes 1, as on the HTTP routes.
